mechanism_narrative: The synchronized sharp declines across RETAIL_REC, PARKS, TRANSIT, and WORKPLACES in the most recent week indicate a tightening restriction regime; this momentum persists and pushes RETAIL_REC further down over the next four weeks as compliance behavior continues.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days despite continued declines in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT in the current week.

mechanism_narrative: A week-on-week rise in RESIDENTIAL mobility above 2 points signals increased time spent at home, which substitutes for retail and recreation trips, driving RETAIL_REC lower over the following two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL rises more than 2 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL rose from 12.6 to 17.9 between t-1w and t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises or stays flat over the next 14 days despite RESIDENTIAL increasing more than 2 points in the current week.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp single-week drop in TRANSIT exceeding 10 points signals reduced mobility capacity for discretionary trips, which mechanically suppresses RETAIL_REC footfall over the following week due to reduced access to shopping districts.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls more than 10 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT fell from -36.1 to -47.0 between t-1w and t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC in the week immediately following the TRANSIT drop is flat or higher than the prior week.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT compound to reduce incidental retail trips tied to commuting (e.g., lunch, errands near work), producing a larger drop in RETAIL_REC than either series alone would predict, over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT fell sharply in t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC decline over the next 28 days is no larger than the decline predicted by WORKPLACES or TRANSIT individually, measured via regression residuals.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC stabilizes or rises over the next 14 days despite GROCERY_PHARM remaining negative.

evidence_refs: fact:PARKS fell from -29.4 to -41.3 between t-1w and t-0w

mechanism_narrative: If the four-week decline pattern represents a seasonal or holiday-driven dip rather than a structural policy shift, mobility will mean-revert within two weeks as routines normalize, lifting RETAIL_REC back toward prior levels.
evidence_refs: fact:all categories show monotonic decline over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC continues to decline or remains flat over the next 14 days instead of reverting upward.
